My plot is small, only 0.13 hectares, and maize is what feeds my family so I must take care of it. I will buy some fertilizer if I can get the subsidy coupon through the AIP program, because without it the maize does not yield enough, but I cannot afford the full recommended amount. I keep a few goats and chickens, so I will spread their manure on the plot before planting, and I intercrop with pigeon peas to help the soil. I will use hybrid seed if the price is reasonable at the ADMARC, but I save some local seed as backup, and I depend on the rains since I have no way to irrigate.
